from copy import deepcopy
import numpy as np
f = np.arange(1, 25, dtype=float)
energies = np.array([0.0, 8.23, 13.17])
omega = 0.47 + 0.041*f + 0.0007*f**2
displacements = np.array([np.zeros(24),
    0.16*np.cos(0.41*f) + 0.04*np.sin(0.17*f),
    0.14*np.sin(0.37*f) - 0.05*np.cos(0.23*f)])
mu0 = np.array([[0.12, 0.83, -0.21], [0.83, -0.17, 0.64], [-0.21, 0.64, 0.09]])
mu1 = np.zeros((24, 3, 3))
mu1[:,0,0] = 0.018*np.cos(0.29*f)
mu1[:,1,1] = -0.024*np.sin(0.31*f)
mu1[:,2,2] = 0.015*np.cos(0.43*f)
mu1[:,0,1] = mu1[:,1,0] = 0.055*np.cos(0.37*f) + 0.021*np.sin(0.13*f)
mu1[:,0,2] = mu1[:,2,0] = -0.047*np.sin(0.23*f) + 0.019*np.cos(0.53*f)
mu1[:,1,2] = mu1[:,2,1] = 0.051*np.cos(0.19*f) - 0.023*np.sin(0.41*f)
waits = np.array([0.37, 0.82, 0.53, 1.14, 0.61])
beta = 0.85

z=displacements[[0,1,2,0]]
dt=np.array([-0.3,0.9,-0.2,-0.4])
h=mu1[:,[0,1,2],[1,2,0]].T
assert np.allclose((lambda r: np.concatenate(([r[0]], np.shape(r[1]), np.ravel(r[1]), np.shape(r[2]), np.ravel(r[2]))))(contour_gaussian(*deepcopy((omega, z, dt, h, beta)))), target)
